infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Samudra Kural requires precise GPS coordinates to calculate live vessel location and dispatch emergency SOS alerts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Continuous GPS updates are required for high-frequency maritime distress telemetry.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bluetooth is required for offline peer-to-peer SOS transmission and nearby vessel discovery.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Bluetooth is required to broadcast emergency SOS distress signals to nearby vessels.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Local Wi-Fi Direct and peer-to-peer networking are required for offline emergency mesh communication.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow Samudra Kural to use Bluetooth for offline emergency peer-to-peer distress communication.
